claim: Bartholomeus is at Zeedijk 267, 8301 Heist; two Michelin stars (2026 Belgium guide); chef Bart Desmidt; 18-seat counter; set menu around seafood.
quote: Bartholomeus is a Two Stars: Excellent cooking restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Belgium. ... Zeedijk 267, Heist, 8301, Belgium ... The 18 seats around the counter are reserved for connoisseurs of high-flying cuisine.

claim: Bruges sits ~20 km from Knokke-Heist; a taxi ride to Bruges takes around 25–30 minutes.
quote: The medieval city of Bruges is just 20km away from Knokke-Heist, and a taxi ride to Bruges takes around 25-30 minutes.

claim: The Siska waffle business in Knokke dates to 1882; Marie Siska and Petrus Dossche opened the Zoutelaan waffle house in 1919; the original waffle irons from 1919 are still in use.
quote: The famous Siska waffles have been baked by the family since 1882. ... In 1919, Marie Siska (1881-1948) and her Dutch entrepreneurial husband Petrus Dossche started a waffle house in Zoutelaan in Knokke. ... the original waffle irons from 1919, cast by Siska's brother-in-law who was a smith, are still used.

claim: Marie Siska Boutique Hotel has seven rooms above the historic waffle house, including a family room and a family suite.
quote: The boutique hotel has 7 rooms including a family room and a family suite.

claim: Hotel Britannia occupies an Anglo-Norman villa at Elizabetlaan 85 in Het Zoute, Knokke-Heist, with 26 rooms (17–50 m²) recently fully renovated inside; ~100 m from the beach.
quote: a gem of Anglo-Norman coastal architecture in the Zoute, Knokke-heist ... Elizabetlaan 85, 8300 - Knokke-Heist ... 26 rooms ranging from 17m² to 50m² ... 328 ft from the beach

claim: Hotel Britannia's Norman villa was built in 1928 and completely renovated in 2022.
quote: The hotel was built in 1928 and was completely renovated in 2022.

claim: Pavillon du Zoute sits at Bronlaan 4, 8300 Knokke-Zoute, with 47 individually designed rooms, indoor pool, sauna and the Pavillon Terre-Mer restaurant; positions itself as a discreet Le Zoute landmark.
quote: Bronlaan 4, 8300 Knokke-Zoute, Belgium ... 47 rooms, each with individual interior design ... You don't come here to be seen — you come here to belong!

claim: Hotel Approach is at Kustlaan 172, 8300 Knokke-Heist; 24 rooms including a junior and royal suite, private terraces overlooking the garden, 75 m from the beach.
quote: Kustlaan 172, 8300 Knokke-Heist ... 24 rooms including a junior and a royal suite ... 75 metres from the beach and 200 metres from the fashionable shopping centre.

claim: All of the art and furnishings in Hotel Approach's rooms are for sale — guests can buy what they slept among.
quote: All of the art and furnishings in the rooms is for sale, which gives it a unique character.

quote: Hotel La Réserve - Knokke-Heist - Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel
